tutorials.title: PulseHMIS Full Tutorial: Download, Install & Use Every Department | Hospital Management System
tutorials.description:
Run your whole hospital or clinic from one system: reception to discharge, pharmacy to billing.

This is the complete PulseHMIS tutorial for hospitals, clinics and health centres. Learn how to download PulseHMIS from our website, install it on Windows, Android and Mac, set it up the first time, and use every part of the system, step by step.

tutorials.title: EduPulse Full Tutorial: Download, Install & Run Your School | School Management System Uganda
tutorials.description:
We have published the complete EduPulse video tutorial.

EduPulse is a school management system by Pulse Generation UG for schools, colleges and universities. In about 11 minutes, the video shows how to download it from our website, install it on Windows, Android and Mac, set it up the first time, and use every module:

• 9-step school setup wizard
• Student admission and profiles
• Classes, subjects and timetable
• Registers in under a minute
• Marks with submit, review and approve
• Report cards: generate, comment, publish and print
• Fees with receipts, expenses and payroll
• Library, sick bay, boarding, store and gate
• Messages to parents and staff

30 days free, then activate with a licence key. If your organisation would like a demonstration, message us on WhatsApp at +256 700 677555 or email lwasapulse11@gmail.com.

Download: https://www.pulsegenerationug.com

notice.text: Android: this update needs a reinstall. Back up first and save the backup outside the app, then uninstall, install the new version and restore. Windows: just run the new Setup.

news.title: PulseConnect 1.4: groups, invite links and faster photos
news.body: Group chats for up to 250 people with admins and invite links that open the app, typing indicators, instant blurred previews for photos and videos, and social links on your profile. Android, Windows and soon Mac.

news.title: MotoPulse 1.1: any country, accounts, bookings and Bay Mode
news.body: Every country and currency with tax, other currencies at your rate, photos at check-in and hand-over, express lane, Bay Mode for wash bays, bookings, wash clubs and parking passes, group accounts for boda stages, profit & loss and loss checks.

news.title: PulseHMIS 2.4: safer pharmacy
news.body: Allergy and duplicate-therapy checks before dispensing and giving doses, a controlled-medicines register with witnesses, quarantine and recall with patient trace, patient returns to quarantine, and a full stock ledger.

news.title: Every currency, up to date
news.body: All Pulse business apps now use the current ISO 4217 currency list (September 2026), with searchable currency pickers. Withdrawn currencies stay readable in old records.

news.title: Remote help from Pulse in every app
news.body: EduPulse, PulseHMIS, PulseStock, PulseProperty Pro and PulseRemit Pro can now receive messages and notices from Pulse Generation UG, like PulseLMIS. PulseHMIS is now available in 13 languages.
